paragraphs: The E-Pace P160 uses the Ingenium AJ150 — a 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol engine. It was fitted from the model's launch in 2017 through to the end of production in 2024 across the X540 generation. The P160 sat as the entry point to the E-Pace petrol range, with the P200 and P250 offering higher-output versions of the same 2.0-litre Ingenium engine family. The E-Pace P160 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 1.5L I3 Petrol engine fitted to the E-Pace P160 — X540 (2017–2024).
